svg.aria-label: WalkieTalkey, open-source Danish dictation, and Edda fine-tuned for developers
svg.title: WalkieTalkey, open-source Danish dictation, and Edda fine-tuned for developers
svg.text: Danish dictation on your own computer.
Hold fn, talk, let go: the text lands where you type. Or
talk into your phone, end-to-end encrypted. No
Fine-tuning Edda, a Danish speech model,
with LoRA on my own voice, so WalkieTalkey
spells the English words we use at work
right, without getting worse at plain Danish.
